title: Systematic benchmarking of AlphaFold and SWISS-MODEL kinase structures for structure-based drug discovery.
one_liner_zh: 该文系统基准测试AlphaFold2与SWISS-MODEL预测的激酶结构在基于结构的药物发现中的对接性能，并评估MD精化对对接的影响，属于蛋白质结构预测与对接的工程化应用，方法创新有限但问题和方法均相关。
abstract: Accurate protein structure prediction is fundamental to structure-based drug discovery. However, the practical performance of deep learning-based models such as AlphaFold compared with traditional homology modeling approaches like SWISS-MODEL remains incompletely evaluated in realistic drug-design workflows. Here, we systematically benchmark AlphaFold2 and SWISS-MODEL using a curated dataset of 20 kinase structures with co-crystallized ligands. Predicted models were evaluated under three conditions: the raw predicted structures, structures subjected to energy minimization, and structures subjected to triplicate 100-ns unbiased molecular dynamics (MD) simulations for structural refinement. Model performance was assessed using structural accuracy metrics, multi-software docking (AutoDock Vina, AutoDock, and MOE), and post-docking MD trajectory stability analysis, together with MM/GBSA binding energy estimation. As expected, experimental structures consistently showed the best docking performance. Among predicted models, SWISS-MODEL produced slightly lower RMSD values and better interaction similarity than AlphaFold, although overall docking scores were statistically comparable. MD refinement prior to docking reduced structural suitability by increasing binding-pocket deviations and was associated with misoriented ligand poses in subsequent docking calculations, while energy minimization provided little to no improvement. Notably, the reduction in docking performance was not limited to computationally predicted structures but was also observed for experimental structures solved in complex with different ligands. Thus, rigid docking alone tended to generate a substantial number of false-positive poses. However, MD simulations applied after docking effectively identified unstable ligand poses and reduced false-positive predictions by detecting ligand dissociation. Overall true-positive rates were 30% for SWISS-MODEL and 35% for AlphaFold2. These findings highlight the importance of dynamic validation in structure-based drug discovery workflows.
abstract_zh: 准确的蛋白质结构预测是基于结构的药物发现的基础。然而，与传统的同源建模方法（如SWISS-MODEL）相比，基于深度学习的模型（如AlphaFold）在实际药物设计工作流程中的性能尚未得到充分评估。在此，我们使用一个包含20个与共结晶配体结合的激酶结构的精选数据集，系统性地对AlphaFold2和SWISS-MODEL进行了基准测试。预测模型在三种条件下进行评估：原始预测结构、经过能量最小化的结构，以及经过三次100纳秒无偏分子动力学（MD）模拟进行结构细化的结构。模型性能通过结构准确性指标、多软件对接（AutoDock Vina、AutoDock和MOE）以及对接后MD轨迹稳定性分析，结合MM/GBSA结合能估算来评估。如预期，实验结构始终表现出最佳的对接性能。在预测模型中，SWISS-MODEL产生的RMSD值略低，且相互作用相似性优于AlphaFold，尽管总体对接分数在统计上相当。对接前的MD细化通过增加结合口袋偏差降低了结构适用性，并与后续对接计算中配体取向错误相关，而能量最小化几乎没有提供改进。值得注意的是，对接性能的下降不仅限于计算预测结构，也出现在与不同配体共结晶的实验结构中。因此，仅刚性对接往往会产生大量假阳性姿态。然而，对接后应用的MD模拟通过检测配体解离，有效识别了不稳定的配体姿态并减少了假阳性预测。总体真阳性率分别为SWISS-MODEL的30%和AlphaFold2的35%。这些发现强调了动态验证在基于结构的药物发现工作流程中的重要性。
